title: Rats in the Mill
about: A first adventure. Brindle's miller wants the giant rats cleared out of his cellar, and pays in coin.

rats.title: Rats in the Mill
rats.offer: Rats, big as dogs, in my cellar! They've had half my grain. Clear them out and I'll pay you 30 gold, and Tamsin will throw in a potion.
rats.done: Miller Hobb weeps with relief and counts out the coins, and Tamsin presses a potion into your hands.

green.name: Brindle Green
green.text: A village green ringed by thatched cottages. A market stall sells odds and ends, and the Mossy Wheel inn faces the old mill across the stream. A flour-dusted man paces by the well.

people.name: Miller Hobb
people.text: A flour-dusted man wringing his cap.
people.says: Please, you look like you can handle yourselves.

people.name: Tamsin
people.says: Rope, torches, a potion if you're feeling rich. Say 'shop' to see what I've got.

mill.name: The Old Mill
mill.text: The waterwheel creaks overhead. Sacks are slumped against the walls, gnawed open, and a heap of fallen beams blocks part of the floor. A trapdoor leads down to the cellar.

cellar.name: The Mill Cellar
cellar.text: A low stone cellar that stinks of wet grain. Red eyes glint between the barrels.
